title: Old Water for Divergence [RESOURCEPACK]
description: A Resource pack that adds the old water color to the Divergence mod.
body:
# This resource pack has been discontinued and is no longer needed!
## After the release of Divergence 1.1.0, you no longer need this resource pack, since the option to change the water appearance is now available in the Video settings by default.



It's a really small resource pack. The only thing it does is bring back the old water color. It doesn't change anything else.

This resource pack is designed to be used alongside the Divergence mod.

You can find the mod here: [https://modrinth.com/mod/divergence](https://modrinth.com/mod/divergence)

All original Minecraft assets are owned by Mojang.
